routes.//: Each demo is a separate application with its own index.html. Naming it explicitly means a directory request can never fall through to the rule below, which would render the portfolio's own shell inside the demo's iframe. That failure is silent and reads as a broken demo rather than a broken route.

The portfolio is a single page application with its own router. Its real files are served by the filesystem handler above; anything else under /theworks is one of its client-side routes and must reach its shell, not the marketing page.
